text: The system shall notify users of the request decision when an administrator approves or rejects an asset request.
The system shall produce the updated operation status only after the approval-start request has been successfully validated and the operation has been executed upon approval.
The system shall define and handle the behavior when modification data fails validation, including whether the user can correct and resubmit the modification form.

The system shall apply defined matching semantics for asset name, type, and ID search criteria in Query Asset Details, specifying whether matching is exact or partial and case-sensitive or case-insensitive.
The system shall allow an administrator to reject a staged transfer request, record the request status as 'Rejected', and leave the asset ownership unchanged.
When an asset return request is denied, the system shall set the return request to the Rejected outcome and notify the requesting user of the denial.
The system shall, when an administrator denies approval of a staged deletion request, set the deletion request status to Rejected and leave the asset record unchanged.

The system shall enforce a defined empty-search policy for Query User Details, including whether at least one of username, email, or department is required and, if empty searches are allowed, the default result set returned.
The system shall resolve the supplied user ID to the corresponding target user record before validating and processing the deletion request.

The system shall define and document the outcome of a senior-admin rejection of a staged workflow modification, including whether the original workflow remains unchanged and the status retained by the workflow.
The system shall notify the affected user(s) when an asset request is approved or rejected.
The system shall record a change-history entry when an asset change occurs, associating it with the asset ID and change details, so that it can be retrieved by the View Asset Change History query.
The system shall record a change type for each asset change event so that the change type can be used as a search criterion in the View Asset Change History query.
The system shall prevent category-edit changes that fail validation from being staged for approval and shall notify the administrator of the validation errors.
The system shall support senior-admin rejection of staged category changes, preserve the original category data, and record the rejection status.
